title: SynthesisPrompts
description: Python-emitted prompts artifact written by --extract-only; consumed by the harness to produce synthesis.json. One prompt entry per synthesis-driven section (§1, §2, §8, §14, §15).

run_id.description: Opaque run identifier; matches the --run-id passed to the CLI and the state-dir subdirectory name.

code_root.description: Absolute path to the analysed source tree, as resolved by the CLI.

sections.description: Ordered list of per-section prompt bundles. Contains exactly the five synthesis-driven sections (§1, §2, §8, §14, §15), but the schema does not enforce ordering or uniqueness — the loader does.

SectionPrompt.title: SectionPrompt
SectionPrompt.description: Prompt bundle for one synthesis-driven playbook section.

number.description: Playbook section number. Constrained to the five synthesis-driven sections.

word_budget.description: Soft word-count target for the section body the harness should produce.

digest_slice.description: Section-relevant subset of AnalysisDigest entities extracted by Python. The harness grounds its analysis in this slice rather than the full digest to bound token cost.

source_files.description: Python-selected bounded set of source file paths (relative to code_root) the harness should Read for deeper grounding.

citation_rule.description: Instruction to the harness on how citations must be formatted (e.g. "Every non-obvious claim carries a `path:line` citation present in code_root.").
